chapter: Chicago, Detroit and Seattle Harmony Kings
title: The Pirate Ship Cafe in Detroit and the Purple Gang
summary: While waiting, they take a job for the Purple Gang boss in Detroit, where Bix and Trumbauer from Goldkette's band often sit in.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Well, in the meantime then, we got an offer to go to the Pirate Ship Cafe in Detroit --

Yeah and pick-up man -- out of Chicago but all good guys - you know and, so, we took it and we went there and first we found out that there we were working for the Purple mob - you know - that's the Purple Gang and, uh, the boss - I can remember the boss - had just beat the rap - the murder rap - and, oh, he was quite a fellow--- and, uh, of course, you've heard of the purple gang--
---they were a very vicious bunch of rum runners--- and, so, we stayed there oh, a month or so. But, I got to see Bix all the time there; he was with Goldkette, now---
Bix and Frankie Trumbauer and all those guys---
Yeah - all those guys were with him and I always thought that the reason Bix - and Trumbauer used to come over and sit in our band, that he didn't get

enough playing in that big band-- he didn't get to play enough jazz in that band; although they had jazz arrangements and good arrangements, I don't think he and Trumbauer got enough playing in it. They used to come over and play in our band because we went to six in the morning, you know. And, so, -- oh, now the time is drawing near when we're suppose to join Nebauer's band - and, so, I -- the boss had taken me out; I had met Miss Detroit at that time---
